title: Closing an Ended Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage Episode
content:
**Rule.** An ended coverage is closed only when its coinsurance balance is zero across every liable party. Open secondary shares are followed up rather than closed out, and a resident share is never written off to close a coverage. A coverage declined as not eligible is never reopened; a later qualifying admission opens a new episode.

Under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage the closing test reads the episode's coinsurance balance from the system record, summed across the resident, the Medigap carrier and the Medicaid crossover.

| Coinsurance balance of the ended episode | Closing |
|---|---|
| Zero across every liable party | The episode may be closed |
| Above zero for any liable party | Not closed; an open secondary share is followed up, and a resident share is never written off to close |

*Hypothetical illustration:* an ended episode whose resident shares are settled but whose Medigap carrier share of 312.40 is unpaid stays open while that share is followed up.
